problem: Frame publication and several closure checks repeatedly scanned the full object map for duplicate or exact-one handle membership, creating quadratic behavior as emitted object counts grow.

details: Added one emitted-handle set and a publication helper that couples handle-index insertion with object-map append across AC1015/1018/1021/1024+ frame writers and raw replay.
Use the index for per-frame duplicate refusal, raw replay duplicate admission, modeler frame closure, named/group dictionary object closure, and class-instance frame closure.
Compound and raw replay rollback erase handles for object-map tail entries they remove; failed map append removes its tentative index entry.
The index replaces the temporary sorted emitted-handle vector from the preceding modeler-replay optimization; final HANDLES sorting and independent duplicate validation remain intact.
Final object-map preflight reuses the synchronized index instead of rebuilding a second ordered set; the cross-version test frame helper publishes through the same ledger.
Extended the existing generated index selector to verify duplicate refusal and rollback removal/retry. No persistent DWG/DXF fixture was added.
implementation.complexity: Per-frame duplicate checks and membership checks change from O(E) scans to average O(1) unordered-set lookup, avoiding O(E^2) cumulative duplicate checking. Handle-set insertion and rollback erasure are average O(1); standard unordered-container worst-case remains linear. The existing final object-map sort/validation remains O(E log E). No benchmark is claimed.
implementation.wire_behavior: Object-map append order, offsets, serialized bytes, handle uniqueness semantics, exact-one closure rules, and support claims are unchanged.
